_comment_about_this_file: Save as `.mcp.json` in a project root to share the server config with your team.
The key is read from your shell env via ${env:...}, so the file is safe to commit.
For personal use prefer: claude mcp add mobileproxy --scope user --env MOBILEPROXY_API_KEY=... -- npx -y @mobileproxy/mcp-server
